DECLARE @today date;
DECLARE @today_last_year date;

DECLARE @current_FY smallint;
DECLARE @last_FY smallint;
DECLARE @current_CY smallint;
DECLARE @last_CY smallint;

DECLARE @current_FQ nvarchar(2);
DECLARE @current_Q tinyint;
DECLARE @current_M tinyint;
DECLARE @current_W tinyint;

SET DATEFIRST 1;

SET @today = DATEADD(day,-1,sysdatetimeoffset() AT TIME ZONE 'Eastern Standard Time')
SET @today_last_year = DATEADD(YEAR,-1,@today); 

SET @current_FY = (SELECT [Fiscal Year] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_FQ = (SELECT [Fiscal Quarter] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_Q = (SELECT [Qtr No.] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_M = (SELECT [Month No.] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_W = DATENAME(ww,@today);

SET @last_FY = @current_FY - 1;
SET @current_CY = YEAR(@today);
SET @last_CY = @current_CY - 1;

UPDATE dr.calendar
SET 

YTD_FLAG = q.YTD_FLAG
,FYTD_FLAG = q.FYTD_FLAG
,FQTD_FLAG = q.FQTD_FLAG
,QTD_FLAG = q.QTD_FLAG
,MTD_FLAG = q.MTD_FLAG
,DAY_FLAG = q.DAY_FLAG
,IS_MONTH_CLOSED = q.IS_MONTH_CLOSED
,WTD_FLAG = q.WTD_FLAG
,DAY_INCLUDE_WEEKEND_FLAG=q.DAY_INCLUDE_WEEKEND_FLAG
FROM (
SELECT [date_key]
	  , CASE WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'FYTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'YTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'FQTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'QTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'MTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Date] <= EOMONTH(DATEADD(month,-1,@today)) THEN 'Y'
	  END as 'IS_MONTH_CLOSED'
	  , CASE WHEN [Date] = @today THEN 'TY' 
		WHEN [Date] = @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
	  END as 'DAY_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND DATENAME(ww,[Date]) = @current_W AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND DATENAME(ww,[Date]) = @current_W THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND DATENAME(ww,DATEADD(ww,52,[Date])) = @current_W AND [Date] <= DATEADD(ww,-52,@today) THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND DATENAME(ww,DATEADD(ww,52,[Date])) = @current_W THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'WTD_FLAG',
	  CASE 
	  WHEN [Date] >= DATEADD(d,-2,@today) and [Date] <=@today 
	  and datename(weekday,sysdatetimeoffset() AT TIME ZONE 'Eastern Standard Time')='Monday'
	  THEN 'TY' 
       WHEN [Date] = @today THEN 'TY' 
	  END as 'DAY_INCLUDE_WEEKEND_FLAG'
  FROM [dr].[calendar] ) q
  WHERE [dr].[calendar].date_key = q.date_key;
